name: Full Stack Open
requirements: Submit enough exercises for a passing grade, then download the certificate from the My submissions tab of the submission system. Assumes prior programming, basic web and Git knowledge.
verificationNote: General info page: "The course is totally free of charge. You can get a certificate and even the University of Helsinki ECTS credits for free." and "the course is open all the time".
notes: Covers React, Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, React Native and containers. The job-interview promise is for residents of Finland only.
why: The university's own page says the course and the certificate are free and that there are no yearly versions or deadlines. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: CS50P: Introduction to Programming with Python
requirements: Submit every problem and the final project and score at least 70% on each.
verificationNote: Certificate page: a score of at least 70% on each of the course's problems and its final project makes you "eligible for a free CS50 Certificate". No deadline is stated.
notes: The edX verified certificate for the same course is a separate, paid option.
why: CS50's own certificate page states the certificate is free and what earns it. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: CS50W: Web Programming with Python and JavaScript
requirements: Submit every project, including the final project, and score at least 70% on each. CS50x or prior programming experience is expected.
verificationNote: Certificate page: at least 70% on each of the course's projects, including the final project, makes you "eligible for a free CS50 Certificate". No deadline is stated.
notes: Uses Django, React and Bootstrap. The edX verified certificate is a separate, paid option.
why: CS50's own certificate page states the certificate is free and what earns it. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Python Essentials 1
certifications: Python Essentials 1 digital badge (Cisco with OpenEDG Python Institute)
requirements: Create a free Networking Academy account, complete the course and pass the course test to receive the Credly badge.
verificationNote: Netacad course page is titled "Free Python Course by Cisco". Credly badge page: issued by Cisco, earned by achieving "a passing score on a comprehensive test".
notes: The separate OpenEDG PCEP certification exam is not part of this offer and its price was not checked.
why: Same shape as the JavaScript Essentials 1 offer already on the site: Cisco's page calls the course free and the Credly page gives the earning criteria. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Data Analysis with Python Certification
requirements: Complete the five required projects (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
verificationNote: freeCodeCamp's own certifications article lists it among 11 certifications, each with 5 required projects. The article dates from March 2022 and the curriculum page could not be read by a script.
notes: freeCodeCamp has reorganised its curriculum since the article; open the curriculum link and confirm the certification is still offered under this name before approving.
why: Named in freeCodeCamp's own list, but that list is from 2022 and the live curriculum page was not readable. Needs a human look at the link. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Python Programming MOOC 2026
certifications: Course certificate (not confirmed on the course page)
requirements: Complete the programming exercises and take part in an exam.
verificationNote: Course page: "The course will be open until the end of the year 2026"; passing requires the exercises and an exam. The page says nothing about a certificate or about cost.
notes: Whether a certificate is issued, and whether it is free, was not confirmed. Dismiss unless the course's FAQ says so.
why: The course and its end date are confirmed, the certificate is not. Queued as a deliberate check-before-you-approve case. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.
